aiControl.title: AI Center
aiControl.sub: Every AI agent: what it is doing, what it cost, what it decided.

master.label: MASTER SWITCH
master.onBody: {n} agent(s) are working inside their caps and limits.
master.offBody: Off until it is turned on. With AI off nothing is sent to any AI company, and every AI feature falls back to its rule or saved template — the shop keeps running as normal.
master.switchLabel: AI master switch: on or off
master.capWarn: No monthly spend cap is set yet. Set one in AI costs so spending can never run away.
master.toastOff: AI is off — the shop keeps running on rules and templates
master.toastFailed: Could not change the AI master switch

agents.title: Agents
agents.sub: Each agent's own switch; the master switch above decides whether any of them may actually work — unless an agent is kept on.
agents.statusWorkingKeptOn: Working — kept on while AI is off
agents.readOnly: You can see the agents; pausing or resuming one needs the AI control permission.

keepOn.label: Keep on even when AI is off
keepOn.switchLabel: Keep {name} on even when AI is off
keepOn.pillOn: Kept on even when AI is off
keepOn.toastOn: {name} will keep working even when AI is off
keepOn.toastOff: {name} now pauses with the master switch

model.label: Model
model.noteSame: This is Claude's own recommended pick for this agent today.
model.noteChanged: This works too. Per-run cost and quality comparisons will show once the AI Cost Book is built (PR 312).
model.noteFallback: {provider} is no longer Tested, so {name} is quietly using the practice writer until it is Tested again or you pick again.
model.toastNotReady: Test that connection in Keys & connections first

schedule.label: Schedule
schedule.always: No time restriction — it only acts on its own triggers, any time.
schedule.nextRunNone: Nothing time-based to preview — it only acts on its own triggers.
schedule.toastInvalid: Pick a clock time (and, for Weekly, at least one day) first
